description: Find the ready-made CucuTime page and free sample link for a child’s first name. Use when a parent wants to visit or listen, rather than brainstorm. When a pre-recorded 30-second sample exists for that name and language, also returns its direct mp3 link (made in advance; no AI runs on the call), plus 3 CucuTime YouTube videos. If no page exists, returns a text idea and sample link instead. Free, no key.
